Slice 5b1 (Task 1, the RSS contract): the rules both lanes enforce and every sentence `qbt rss` prints, so neither lane hand-copies a message. qbt (Task 2: lib/rssrules.py, lib/rssitems.py, tests/test_rss.py) is the enforcing check and the window (Task 3: RssView.js, tests/rss-view.test.js) only pre-checks; both must accept exactly the ok cases and refuse the rest with exactly the message given. See tests/fixtures/rss-contract.md for the stdin framing and JSON shapes. cases: {kind, input, ok, normalised?, message?, why}; message is present exactly when ok is false, and is always one of `sentences`; why labels a failed assertion. Every rule reads the input exactly as given. The URL text rule, BAD, CONTROL and the host rule are 5b0's (link-rules-cases.json, LinkRules.js, lib/linkrules.py): a URL is split by hand, never by a URL library; CONTROL is [�--]; a host is lowercased, IDN labels become xn-- punycode, and a %-escape, a trailing dot, an empty label or a bad port is refused. kind feedUrl (a's first INSERT, qbt rss add-feed): checked in this order, the first failure's message wins: empty (feedUrlEmpty); BAD or | anywhere (feedUrlBad); not starting http:// or https://, scheme matched case-insensitively (feedUrlScheme); an @ in the authority (feedUrlUser); a host or port the host rule refuses (feedUrlHost). When ok, normalised is the host as the name prompt prefills it (lower case, IDN as punycode, no port); qbt posts the URL exactly as given. kind name (a feed or folder name: a's second INSERT, N, n; qbt checks every `\`-separated segment of a path the same way): first trimmed at both ends with Qt's QChar::isSpace set (U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000; ruling FE: U+FEFF is not a space and is kept), then in this order: nothing left (nameEmpty); a \ anywhere (nameBackslash); a CONTROL character anywhere (nameControl). When ok, normalised is the trimmed name. kind hasTorrent (Enter's add rule, D4, OV1 and the D4 exception; qbt rss add and the items' hasTorrent flag): input {torrentURL, link}, checked in this order: torrentURL empty (noTorrent); BAD or | anywhere in torrentURL (badTorrentLink); torrentURL starting magnet:? (case-insensitive) is ok with normalised "magnet"; not starting http:// or https:// (badTorrentLink); an @ in the authority, or a host or port the host rule refuses (badTorrentLink); torrentURL not equal to link (exact string comparison) is ok with normalised "url"; equal to link and the path (after the authority, before ? or #) ending in .torrent, case-insensitive, is ok with normalised "url"; otherwise noTorrent. There is no .torrent test on a URL that differs from link (download.php?id= links are normal). kind errorReason (qbt rss error, D6/OV13): input {log, url}, log being log/main rows ({id, message, timestamp, type}; type is not checked, since qbt asks for warnings only). A row matches when its message starts with exactly "Failed to download RSS feed at '" + url + "'. Reason: " or "Failed to parse RSS feed at '" + url + "'. Reason: " (a prefix test, never a pattern, so a ' in the URL is safe); its reason is the rest of the message, as is. The matching row with the highest id wins. Always ok; normalised is that reason, or null when no row matches (another URL, or a translated message). kind articleText (qbt rss article, D11/OV6): input is a description's HTML; always ok; normalised is {text, truncated}. The HTML goes through Python's html.parser.HTMLParser (convert_charrefs=True, so entities are decoded in the text). Everything inside script and style is dropped. Comments, CDATA sections, declarations and processing instructions are dropped. Each start tag and each end tag named p, div, li, tr, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5 or h6 becomes one ; a br start tag (
or
) becomes one and a
nothing; a self-closing block tag (

) counts as its start tag only (one ; override handle_startendtag, whose default would also call handle_endtag); every other tag becomes nothing. In the text itself each run of [ \v] becomes one space (U+00A0 and other characters are kept, bidi controls included: the window strips those). Then the result is split on ; in each line runs of spaces become one space and spaces at both ends are removed; the lines are joined with ; every run of 4 or more becomes (at most 2 blank lines in a row); and at the start and end are removed. Last, the text is capped at 4096 code points: a longer text keeps its first 4096 code points, with no ellipsis, and truncated is true. sentences: every other line qbt prints (usage, 409s passed through in plain words, read-back failures). window: the window's copy, including the five needs reasons as the status line shows them (CommandRegistry.needsReason returns each without its full stop, starting lower case unless it starts with RSS or qBittorrent) and the INSERT prompts. In every text, , , <host>, <n> and <reason> are filled in by the caller; no other placeholder exists.
